name: factory-monitor
title_zh: 一眼看清工厂健康度，不碰修复只做诊断
tagline_zh: 仓库积压、CI 红黄、安全公告、陈旧工作全在眼前。不写一行修复代码，先看清哪里在漏，再决定动哪里。
tagline_en: See stale work, CI status, security advisories, and run evidence at a glance. Diagnose first, fix later—no code.
desc_en: Inspect factory health, stale work, CI, security advisories, and recent run evidence without implementing fixes.
why_zh: 它把分散在 GitHub 各处的信号聚成一张健康快照，只读不改，让你在动手前先看清全局，避免盲修。
why_en: It aggregates scattered GitHub signals into a read-only health snapshot, so you see the whole picture before touching anything.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 GitHub 仓库的元数据与 CI 状态，不读代码内容、不分析日志细节；产物是诊断清单，不包含任何修复建议或补。
limit_en: Only covers GitHub repo metadata and CI status; no code analysis or log details. Output is a diagnostic list, no fixes or patches.
